summary: The article presents CV->0, an operational protocol for equation discovery that prioritizes mechanical refusal and invariant certification over mere predictive approximation. Supported by extensive code repositories, empirical benchmarking against PySR across 12 tasks, and a lithium-ion battery capacity fade case study, it provides rigorous methodological contributions to symbolic regression.
strengths: Introduction of a rigorous mechanical adjudication protocol and refusal taxonomy (DATA, GRAMMAR, NOISE, DEPTH) that guards against overfitting and hallucination.
Comprehensive empirical benchmarking comparing performance directly against PySR with controlled budgets and reproducible splits.
Thoroughly documented reproducibility package including compliance matrices, compliance criteria maps, and open-source PHP implementations.
Real-world application case study on lithium-ion capacity fade demonstrating practical utility and catching ratio-CV artifacts.
weaknesses: Language ontogeny and word transfer claims are currently demonstrated on a single transfer pair, requiring wider empirical generalization.
Some extended protocol criteria (Stages 1-3) remain partially implemented, requiring careful distinction between verified base criteria and future work.
suggestions: Expand language ontogeny experiments to multiple cross-domain transfer chains to solidify the vocabulary growth claims.
Provide extended documentation on tuning boundaries for the PySR baseline comparison.

claims.text: Symbolic regression systems are optimized to answer: given data, return a formula. We argue that for scientific discovery, the more valuable capability is to refuse

On a 12-task benchmark spanning Feynman physics and real-world datasets, our implementation achieves 6 wins, 3 operational parities, and 0 losses against PySR under comparable per-seed wall-clock budgets
Stretched-exponential master curve: refuted as universal; it is needed exactly where alpha is stable and below 1 (our LCO subset) and dominated by the power law elsewhere.

novelty_vs_existing.title: CVEvolve: Autonomous Algorithm Discovery for Unstructured Scientific Data Processing
novelty_vs_existing.contribution: While CVEvolve targets autonomous algorithm discovery via LLM wrappers, CV->0 focuses explicitly on mechanical adjudication, null-calibration, and principled refusal categories (DATA/GRAMMAR/NOISE/DEPTH) rather than general evolutionary program synthesis.

novelty_vs_existing.title: Interpretable Machine Learning for Science with PySR and SymbolicRegression.jl
novelty_vs_existing.contribution: PySR optimizes predictive fitness and returns expressions without an invariant/refusal gate, whereas CV->0 introduces a strict multi-gate validation pipeline to separate approximations from true invariants and refuse uncertified outputs.
